tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /myur mdzad yid bzhin nor bu'i bstod pa rje bla mas mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mo lo ke shwa ra ye/ phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpal ster ljon pa'i tshal/ /ha ri tsan dan nags tshal 'khrigs pa'i khrod/ /me mtshams 'jigs pa'i dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal/ /rin chen sdong chen rgyas pa'i grib bsil la/ /chu skyes dga' ma 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i spor/ /nyi gzhon gzhon nus 'khyud pa'i zlos gar rtser/ /kha ba'i phung po zung gi dpal 'phrog pa'i/ /bgegs chen nor bu'i char 'bebs spyi bo'i steng / /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos pad dkar can/ /'gro 'di phun tshogs re ba skong ba'i slad/ /rab brjid khro bo'i dbang por sprul pa la/ /'di na yid bzhin nor bur mtshan gsol ba/ /khyod ni gangs kyi ri bo chen po'am/ /dung dang pad rtsa kun+da chu shel ltar/ /sprin dkar gsar pa'i ngos la nyi 'od kyis/ /lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i yid 'ong gzi 'od 'bar/ /e ma dpa' bo khyod kyi zhal bzang ni/ /snying dbus dran pa'i mod la dbul 'phongs kyi/ /sdug bsngal ma lus ming gi mthar byas te/ /srid gsum snod bcud dbang byed sgyu 'phrul mtshar/ /khro 'dzum bzhad pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /li khri'i 'od chags dbu skyes smin mas spud/ /spyan gsum rab g.yo mche ba'i myu gu mdzes/ /bim pa ltar dmar mchu sgros ljags 'gril zhing / /sin+dhur gsar pa'i thig les dpral bar byugs/ /rigs bdag mi bskyod rdo rje'i cod paṇa can/ /rin chen rgyan 'phreng nor bu'i lan tshar dang / /sil sil dril bu g.yer kha'i drwa ba 'khrol/ /ser sna 'joms pa'i rdo rje gri gug dang / /dgos 'dod kun stsol yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /ḍā ki dbang sdud cang te'u sgra ldan pas/ /khyod sku'i g.yas kyi phyag bsnams rim par mdzes/ /'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin bdud rtsi'i bum thod dang / /dug gsum 'joms pa'i mtshon cha tri shu la/

/srid gsum 'gugs pa'i rdo rje lcags kyu yis/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi g.yon pa'i phyag bsnams 'grel/ /khrag dang bcas pa'i glang lpags stod g.yogs bgos/ /stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs mdzes pa dkris/ /thod skam lngas brgyan khrag 'dzag mgo 'phreng gis/ /rgyu mar bcangs pa'i do shal ring du 'phyang / /bgegs chen zung gi spyi bor zhabs gnyis ni/ /ro ldan gnas nas rim par da lta nyid/ /byon zhing bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis bar snang khyon/ /ma lus khyab pa'i me dpung dbus na 'gying / /gang de'i spyi bor bla ma brgyud pa yi/ /bla ma kun 'dus pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /yid bzhin nor dang dril bus phyag gnyis spras/ /spyan zur bsgyur bas ḍā ki dbang du byed/ /mgon po'i thugs kar gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /lang tsho rab rgyas sin+dhur tshal zhun mdog /lcags kyu thod pa thogs pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /srid gsum skad cig nyid la 'gugs par byed/ /gzhan yang 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs gnod sbyin dang / /khams gsum dbang sdud ḍā ki bgrang yas tshogs/ /bka' nyan yum mchog 'dod khams dbang mo che/ /'khor chen bzhi sogs dam can rgya mtshor 'dud/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas gtor ma'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang khyon khengs pas/ /'bul lo mchod do myur mdzad nag po che/ /khyod kyi dang por thugs dam bcas pa dang / /rdo rje 'chang dbang rtsa brgyud bla ma yi/ /bka' dang dam tshig rjes su dran mdzod la/ /thub pa'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i/ /dbul zhing 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas dang / /bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang dbang phyug dang / /longs spyod snyan grags lung rtogs yon tan tshogs/ /thos bsam sgom dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/

/'phrin las phyogs bcu kun tu dar rgyas mdzod/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes bu ji snyed dang / /stobs ldan btsan phyug ldan pa'i 'gro mang tshogs/ /dregs ldan 'byung po mkho dgu'i nor rdzas rnams/ myur ba nyid du bdag gis dbang du bsdus/ /zhes myur mdzad yid bzhin gyi nor bu la bstod cing 'phrin las su gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis yol bu ri gong gi mgon po rang byon gyi drung du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ myur mdzad yid bzhin nor bu'i bstod pa rje bla mas mdzad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
